takbeer.title: Takbeer
takbeer.action: Raise hands to ears and recite Takbeer

qiyam_1.title: First Qiyam
qiyam_1.action: Sit upright, remain steady, and recite Surah al-Fatihah and a second Surah

qiyam_2.title: Second Qiyam
qiyam_2.action: Sit upright and recite Surah al-Fatihah and a second Surah before Qunoot

qiyam_generic.title: Qiyam
qiyam_generic.transliteration: Subḥān Allāh, wa l-ḥamd li-llāh, wa lā ilāh-a illā Allāh, wa Allāh Akbar
qiyam_generic.action: Sit upright and recite Tasbihat al-Arba'ah

qunoot.title: Qunoot
qunoot.transliteration: Rabbanā-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā, wathabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn
qunoot.action: Raise your hands in front of your face, palms facing up, and recite your supplication

ruku.title: Ruku
ruku.action: Bow your upper body deeply forward from your seated position

sujud_1.title: First Sujud
sujud_1.action: Lean forward and place your forehead firmly down on your thumbs or turbah

jalsah.title: Jalsah
jalsah.action: Sit back upright steadily between your prostrations

sujud_2.title: Second Sujud
sujud_2.action: Lean forward for your second prostration

tashahhud_mid.title: Tashahhud
tashahhud_mid.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ...
tashahhud_mid.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-llah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasulullah.
tashahhud_mid.action: Recite the mid-prayer Tashahhud declaration while seated upright

tashahhud_final.title: Tashahhud & Salam
tashahhud_final.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ... السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ...
tashahhud_final.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-llah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasulullah. Allahumma salli ala Muhammad.
tashahhud_final.action: Recite the final Tashahhud and conclude your prayer with the Salam greetings

ruku_guide.title: Ruku Guide
ruku_guide.action: Seated Ruku placement rules for praying in wheelchair

sujud_guide.title: Sujud Guide
sujud_guide.action: Seated Sujud hand placement for praying in a wheelchair
